
══════════════════════════════════════════
  HUNT: Obfuscation Detection
══════════════════════════════════════════

  VERDICT     LIKELY — one structural indicator (sleep-mask decode or PE payload)
  Confidence  high
  Score       1/2
  Coverage    COMPLETE
  Review      high

  KEY SIGNALS

  [!] DETECTION  Structural PE payload inside encoded data
      Decoded/decompressed content from one or more obfuscation layers structurally validates as a
      PE image.

  [i] CONTEXT    Base64 encoded payloads
      1 region(s) contain data that decodes cleanly as Base64.

  WHY THIS VERDICT

  Inference
    Decoded/decompressed content from one or more obfuscation layers structurally validates as a PE
    image.

  Confidence: HIGH
    Unlike raw entropy/Base64/GZIP presence, this checks WHAT the decoded bytes actually are: full
    PE structural validation (DOS/COFF/optional header + complete section table). Encoding was only
    the delivery mechanism here — the payload itself is the evidence.

  Caveat
    Structural validation reduces but does not eliminate false positives from adversarially-crafted
    or coincidental byte sequences in high-entropy data.

  Use --verbose for complete per-region evidence, file offsets, and decoded content.
